title: 第19章 杨康18第20章 杨康19
content_zh:
黄蓉在郭靖面前虽然没什么脾气，甚至可以说百依百顺，但她骨子里可是将自家老爹东邪的高傲学了个十成十。
于是面对华筝的质问，她也毫不客气的回嘴道：“我不会出主意？那你会吗？说到底还是你们蒙古将士能力不足，不然怎么会这样！”
华筝听到黄蓉如此侮辱自家人，直接也不忍了。她被父汗兄长宠爱多年，自然也不是没脾气的人，蒙古勇士骁勇善战，岂能让黄蓉如此污蔑！
“你胡说什么！蒙古勇士骁勇善战，你怎敢胡言乱语！当心我告知父汗，让他......”
郭靖这些日子接连失利，这会听着她们又开始争吵，忍不住说道：“你们两个能不能闭嘴，都别吵了！让我好好静一静，一会还要去中军大帐呢！”
“靖哥哥，你!”
“郭靖，你怎么这样啊！”
两个人都不敢相信郭靖会这样说自己，但又不愿意在情敌面前丢面子，只好忍下心里的怒火，默默走到一旁坐了下来！
黄蓉自诩才智过人，看着自家靖哥哥苦恼的样子，心里又开始默默盘算着武穆遗书该如何用！她是真的心疼自家靖哥哥！
随着郭靖在战场上的节节失利，蒙古大军的士气早已大不如前，更何况寒冬即将到来，蒙古草原粮草已经捉襟见肘！虽说大宋那边提供了一部分粮草，但这只是杯水车薪！而大金那边早就依靠西域商道解决了粮草受制于人的情况！
铁木真虽说有雄心壮志，但手下如今并不是铁板一块！郭靖损兵折将太过严重，几乎是被金国压着打，不少将领都纷纷指责郭靖，想要换将，毕竟在战场上牺牲的都是他们部族的勇士，甚至还有亲朋好友！蒙古人口本就不多，哪里能让人如此霍霍！
当然！这其中也少不了铁木真儿子的插手！毕竟郭靖是金刀驸马，算是托雷那边的人，如果能把郭靖换下去，也算是打击托雷的势力了！
看着手下人的样子，铁木真管得了人却管不了心，心里不免对蒙古的前景充满了担忧。
杨康倒是不知道郭靖那边的近况，但他从手下将领的汇报中也能看出一二。
身边两女相争，还要受到其他势力的打压，郭靖现在应该很苦恼吧！
随着时间的推进，大金对蒙古战事已经逐渐明了起来，铁木真即使再怎么欣赏郭靖，也不得不将他换下来。
其实蒙古兵士倒也不是人人都对郭靖心服口服的！
诚然郭靖的战力很强，但战场上依靠的并不仅仅是主帅的战力，更多的是统帅的指挥能力，郭靖在这方面做的并不好，再加上郭靖本就是宋人，身边还跟着宋人姑娘，蒙古众人对他不满的大有人在，现在郭靖领兵不利，他们自然也不想做无谓的牺牲！
其实黄蓉是个聪明人，她已经意识到自己犯的错误了，但却没什么用了！
毕竟郭靖的免职已经出来了，他们也指挥不了蒙古军队了！

对于这个结果，托雷虽然不满，但铁木真的其他儿子却很满意！敌人的失败就是我们的成功！
杨康看着手下送上来的奏折，想要速战速决解决蒙古，心里倒是没什么意见！
毕竟打仗最是烧钱费人，能尽快解决也是好事！因此也就爽快的同意了，并且让欧阳克做好后勤工作！
得到消息的欧阳克只觉得杨康不做人！后勤不是那么好做的啊！
‘巧妇难为无米之炊’知道吗？大雪漫天的情况下，粮食运输都受到影响，这让他怎么办？
欧阳克心里骂骂咧咧，但该干的还是要干！毕竟他也想还杨康人情，想让白驼山庄更上一层楼！
有了自家皇帝的支持，大金军队的攻势越发的凶猛！
看着日益低迷的士气，后续不济的粮草，虽然知道再打下去必败，但铁木真还是无可奈何下达了进攻的命令！
毕竟现在已经不是他能决定进退的时候了，即使他退了，大金的军队也不会退啊！而且他的骄傲也不允许他投降敌人！
在一方准备充足，另一方人心涣散的情况下，蒙古大军毫无疑问的败了！
消息传到中都的那一刻，杨康不免兴奋了起来！虽然这是武侠世界，但他居然赢了成吉思汗，这怎么能不让人兴奋呢！
不过经历过现代熏陶的杨康倒也没对蒙古做什么，毕竟他可是听着‘五十六个民族是一家’长大的！
该杀的杀，该放的放！不过为了恶心郭靖黄蓉，杨康特意留下来华筝的性命，他倒要看看原着中满口道德仁义的郭靖未来会怎么选择！
人与人的悲喜并不相通！蒙古败落的消息传到大宋以后，大家都知道宋金两国迟早开战！有见识的人倒是想劝自家皇上富国强兵，但架不住皇帝支棱不起来，朝中有人从中作梗，最后也只能不了了之！
郭靖黄蓉倒是趁着蒙古战败带着郭母回到了中原，只不过这次不会有‘北侠’的名声了！
其实郭靖是想带着华筝一起走的，但黄蓉怎么可能会愿意！她早就受够这个女人了！
郭母倒是想带华筝一起走，但黄蓉的脑子可不是一般人能比得上的。所以最后也只是郭靖。郭母还有黄蓉一起回到了中原！
至于其他人，蒙古勇士岂会不战而退！
杨康倒是没有急着对大宋用兵，毕竟虽然蒙古战败，但后续要处理的事情还有很多！
值得一提的是，大宋看到盟友的下场，瑟瑟发抖，倒是主动派人来说要与大金重修旧好，甚至岁币什么的都好商量！

杨康对此倒是不置可否，反正送上门的东西不要白不要！他也确实没打算在短时间内对大宋用兵，毕竟军队要休整，粮草要储备，蒙古要镇压安抚！实在是腾不出手来了！
在两方各有思量的情况下，两国之间重新签订的盟约！
大宋掌权人倒是松了一口气，继续沉迷在西湖歌舞几时休的欢乐中，殊不知这是末日的狂欢了！
如洪七公郭靖等爱国人士自然是不满的，但却改变不了什么！毕竟国与国的斗争，他们的力量太过渺小！
郭靖倒是去襄阳从军了，但和原着不同的是，这次真的只是一个小兵！
content_en:
Although Huang Rong had no temper in front of Guo Jing and could even be said to be submissive, she had imitated the arrogance of her father Dong Xie to 10%.
So when faced with Hua Zheng's question, she retorted unceremoniously: "I can't come up with ideas? Then can you? In the final analysis, you Mongolian soldiers are not capable enough, otherwise how could this happen!"
When Hua Zheng heard Huang Rong insulting her family, she couldn't bear it anymore. She has been favored by her father and brother Khan for many years, so she is naturally not a temperless person. The Mongolian warriors are brave and good at fighting, how can Huang Rong slander her like this!
"What nonsense are you talking about! Mongolian warriors are brave and good at fighting, how dare you talk nonsense! Be careful, I will tell my father Khan and let him..."
Guo Jing has been losing one after another these days. Hearing them start to argue again, he couldn't help but say: "Can you two shut up and stop arguing! Let me have some peace and quiet. I have to go to the Chinese army's tent soon!"
"Brother Jing, you!"
"Guo Jing, why are you like this!"
Both of them couldn't believe that Guo Jing would say this about themselves, but they didn't want to lose face in front of their love rival, so they had no choice but to endure the anger in their hearts and silently walked aside and sat down!
Huang Rong prided herself on being extremely intelligent. Seeing her brother Jing's troubled expression, she began to think about how to use Wu Mu's suicide note! She really felt sorry for her brother Jing!
With Guo Jing's defeats on the battlefield, the morale of the Mongolian army has already dropped sharply. What's more, the cold winter is coming, and the Mongolian grasslands are already running out of food and grass! Although the Song Dynasty provided some food and grass, it was only a drop in the bucket! And Daikin has long relied on the Western Regions Trade Route to solve the problem of food and grass being controlled by others!
Although Temujin is ambitious, his men are not monolithic now! Guo Jing lost so many soldiers and generals that he was almost suppressed by the Jin Kingdom. Many generals accused Guo Jing and wanted to change their generals. After all, those who died on the battlefield were the warriors of their tribes, and even their relatives and friends! Mongolia has a small population, so how can people be so excited!
certainly! The intervention of Temujin's son was also indispensable! After all, Guo Jing is the Consort of the Golden Sword, and he is considered to be on Torre's side. If Guo Jing can be replaced, it can be regarded as a blow to Torre's forces!
Looking at the appearance of his men, Temujin could manage people but could not control their hearts, and he couldn't help but feel worried about the future of Mongolia.
Yang Kang didn't know the current situation at Guo Jing's side, but he could tell something from the reports of his generals.
Guo Jing must be very distressed now with two women fighting against each other and being suppressed by other forces!
As time went on, Daikin's war against Mongolia gradually became clear, and no matter how much Temujin admired Guo Jing, he had to replace him.
In fact, not everyone among the Mongolian soldiers was convinced by Guo Jing!
It is true that Guo Jing's combat power is very strong, but what he relies on on the battlefield is not only the commander's combat power, but also the commander's command ability. Guo Jing is not good in this regard. In addition, Guo Jing is from the Song Dynasty, and he is accompanied by a Song girl. There are many people in Mongolia who are dissatisfied with him. Now that Guo Jing is not leading the army, they naturally do not want to make unnecessary sacrifices!
In fact, Huang Rong is a smart person. She has realized the mistake she made, but it is of no use!
After all, Guo Jing's dismissal has come out, and they can no longer command the Mongolian army!
Although Torre was dissatisfied with this result, Temujin's other sons were very satisfied! The enemy's failure is our success!
Yang Kang looked at the memorial sent by his subordinates and wanted to solve Mongolia quickly, but he didn't have any objections in his heart!
After all, fighting costs money and people the most, so it’s a good thing to resolve it as soon as possible! Therefore, I readily agreed and asked Ouyang Ke to do the logistics work!
After receiving the news, Ouyang Ke only felt that Yang Kang was not a good person! Logistics is not that easy!
You know, ‘It’s hard for a clever woman to make a meal without rice’? heavy snowUnder such circumstances, food transportation was affected. What should he do?
Ouyang Ke cursed in his heart, but he still had to do what he had to do! After all, he also wants to repay Yang Kang's favor and wants to bring White Camel Villa to a higher level!
With the support of his own emperor, the offensive of the Dajin army became more and more fierce!
Looking at the increasingly sluggish morale and the lack of follow-up supplies, although he knew that he would lose if he continued to fight, Temujin still had no choice but to give the order to attack!
After all, it is no longer the time for him to decide whether to advance or retreat. Even if he retreats, Daikin's army will not retreat! And his pride does not allow him to surrender to his enemies!
With one side fully prepared and the other side demoralized, the Mongolian army was undoubtedly defeated!
The moment the news reached Zhongdu, Yang Kang couldn't help but become excited! Although this is the world of martial arts, he actually defeated Genghis Khan. How can this not be exciting!
However, Yang Kang, who has experienced modern influence, did not do anything to Mongolia. After all, he grew up hearing that "56 ethnic groups are one family"!
Kill those who deserve to be killed, and let go of those who deserve to be killed! However, in order to disgust Guo Jing and Huang Rong, Yang Kang deliberately kept Hua Zheng alive. He wanted to see what Guo Jing, who was full of morality and justice in the original work, would choose in the future!
The joys and sorrows of people are not the same! After the news of the fall of Mongolia reached the Song Dynasty, everyone knew that the Song and Jin countries would go to war sooner or later! The knowledgeable people wanted to persuade their emperor to enrich the country and strengthen the army, but they couldn't stand it and the emperor couldn't stand it. There were people in the court who were obstructing it, so in the end they had no choice but to let it go!
Guo Jing and Huang Rong took advantage of Mongolia's defeat and took Guo's mother back to the Central Plains, but this time they would not have the reputation of 'Northern Hero'!
In fact, Guo Jing wanted to take Hua Zheng with him, but how could Huang Rong be willing? She has had enough of this woman for a long time!
Guo's mother wanted to take Hua Zheng with her, but Huang Rong's brain was not comparable to that of ordinary people. So in the end it was just Guo Jing. Guo's mother and Huang Rong returned to the Central Plains together!
As for the others, how could the Mongolian warriors retreat without a fight?
Yang Kang was not in a hurry to use troops against the Song Dynasty. After all, although Mongolia was defeated, there were still many things to deal with in the future!
It is worth mentioning that Da Song trembled when he saw the fate of his allies, but he took the initiative to send someone to say that he wanted to rebuild the old relationship with Da Jin, and even discuss things like Sui coins!
Yang Kang was noncommittal about this. Anyway, the things delivered to your door should not be free of charge! He indeed had no plans to use troops against the Song Dynasty in a short period of time. After all, the army needed to rest and recuperate, food and grass needed to be stored, and Mongolia needed to be suppressed and appeased! I really can’t spare any time!
With both parties having their own considerations, the alliance was re-signed between the two countries!
The rulers of the Song Dynasty breathed a sigh of relief and continued to indulge in the joy of West Lake singing and dancing. Little did they know that this was the end of the carnival!
Patriots such as Hong Qigong and Guo Jing are naturally dissatisfied, but nothing can be changed! After all, in the struggle between countries, their power is too small!
Guo Jing went to Xiangyang to join the army, but unlike the original work, he was really just a soldier this time!
